title: Pope Leo XIV Recovering After Successful Lung Cancer Surgery
subtitle: The 71-year-old pontiff is expected to remain in the hospital for a week following a procedure to remove a cancerous growth.

summary.en: Pope Leo XIV has undergone a successful surgery to remove a cancerous growth from his right lung. The 71-year-old leader is currently recovering at Rome's Gemelli Hospital. Doctors confirmed a diagnosis of lung adenocarcinoma after the procedure. The Vatican has cleared the Pope's schedule until October 20 to allow for rest. Despite the diagnosis, the Pope remains hopeful about his upcoming trip to Latin America.
summary.zh: 教宗利奧十四世已成功接受手術，切除了右肺的癌性腫瘤。這位七十一歲的領袖目前正在羅馬的傑梅利醫院休養。醫師在術後證實其診斷為肺腺癌。梵蒂岡已取消教宗至十月二十日前的行程以利休養。儘管確診罹癌，教宗對即將到來的拉丁美洲之行仍抱持希望。

paragraphs.en: Pope Leo XIV is recovering in a Rome hospital following a successful operation to remove a cancerous growth from his lung. The 71-year-old leader underwent the procedure on Tuesday at Gemelli Hospital, a facility that has treated many popes in the past. According to a medical bulletin from the Vatican, surgeons removed the lower lobe of the Pope’s right lung to ensure the procedure was complete. Tests performed after the surgery confirmed the growth was lung adenocarcinoma, a common form of lung cancer.
paragraphs.zh: 教宗利奧十四世（Pope Leo XIV）在羅馬一家醫院接受了肺部腫瘤切除手術，手術相當成功，目前正在康復中。這位七十一歲的領袖於週二在傑梅利醫院（Gemelli Hospital）接受了這項程序，該院過去曾治療過多位教宗。根據梵蒂岡發布的醫療公報，外科醫師切除了教宗右肺的下葉，以確保手術徹底。術後檢測證實該腫瘤為肺腺癌，這是一種常見的肺癌類型。

paragraphs.en: The Vatican stated that the operation lasted about 90 minutes and was successful, with no complications. The Pope awoke normally after the surgery and returned to his hospital room after a short period of observation. While the Vatican has not announced any further treatments, they noted that the Pope is expected to remain in the hospital for about a week to recover. All of the pontiff's public engagements have been cancelled until October 20.
paragraphs.zh: 梵蒂岡表示，手術歷時約九十分鐘且過程順利，沒有出現併發症。教宗在術後正常甦醒，經過短暫觀察後便回到病房。雖然梵蒂岡尚未宣布後續的治療計畫，但指出教宗預計需在醫院休養約一週。教宗在十月二十日前的所有公開行程皆已取消。

paragraphs.en: This health news follows a direct announcement from the Pope himself. On Sunday, while speaking to crowds in St Peter's Square, Leo XIV told followers that doctors had found a growth on his lung. He explained that the nodule—a small growth—was found at a very early stage and was contained. He decided to have the surgery quickly because he is eager to keep his planned travel schedule, which includes a trip to Latin America in early November. This visit is particularly important to the Pope, as he previously served as a missionary and a bishop in Peru for many years.
paragraphs.zh: 這項健康消息源自教宗本人的直接宣布。週日，利奧十四世在聖伯多祿廣場（St Peter's Square）向群眾發表談話時，告知信徒醫師在他的肺部發現了腫瘤。他解釋說，這個結節（即小型腫瘤）是在非常早期的階段被發現的，且病灶侷限於局部。他決定儘快接受手術，是因為他希望能如期完成預定的行程，其中包括十一月初前往拉丁美洲的訪問。這次訪問對教宗而言意義重大，因為他過去曾長期在秘魯擔任傳教士與主教。

paragraphs.en: Experts have shared a positive outlook regarding his health. According to oncologists mentioned by Deutsche Welle, the Pope has an excellent chance of a full recovery because the cancer was caught early. A source within the Vatican told Agence France-Presse that medical teams are performing additional tests to confirm that the cancer has not spread to other parts of his body. Despite the positive reports, the news has been difficult for many followers. Vatican Secretary of State Cardinal Parolin admitted to journalists that the news was a surprise, describing it as a "bolt from the blue," but he added that the church leadership remains confident in the Pope's recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 專家對他的健康狀況抱持樂觀態度。根據德國之聲（Deutsche Welle）引述的腫瘤科醫師說法，由於癌症發現得早，教宗完全康復的機率極高。一位梵蒂岡內部的消息人士向法新社（Agence France-Presse）透露，醫療團隊正在進行額外檢測，以確認癌症未擴散至身體其他部位。儘管報導正面，這則消息對許多信徒來說仍難以接受。梵蒂岡國務卿帕羅林樞機（Cardinal Parolin）向記者坦言，這則消息令人震驚，形容為「晴天霹靂」，但他補充說，教會領導層對教宗的康復充滿信心。

paragraphs.en: Public reaction has been one of concern and support. Outside the hospital, crowds gathered to cheer for the Pope as he arrived. One visitor, Carla, told the BBC that seeing the Pope stay calm helped the public feel more at ease. "He seems calm, so we are calm too," she said. The Pope, who is known for being physically active and enjoying tennis and horse riding, showed his usual spirit by smiling and waving to staff and supporters as he entered the hospital.
paragraphs.zh: 大眾的反應充滿了關懷與支持。在醫院外，群眾聚集為抵達的教宗歡呼。一名訪客卡拉（Carla）告訴英國廣播公司（BBC），看到教宗保持冷靜，讓大眾感到比較安心。她說：「他看起來很平靜，所以我們也跟著平靜下來。」教宗向來以熱愛運動、喜歡網球與騎馬聞名，他在進入醫院時仍展現一貫的精神，微笑並向工作人員與支持者揮手致意。

paragraphs.en: This situation also highlights a change in how the Vatican handles information about the health of the leader. By speaking openly about his condition, Pope Leo XIV has moved away from the more private approach taken by his predecessors. In the past, the Vatican was often criticized for being vague or unclear about the health of popes. By choosing to be transparent, the current administration is providing more direct updates to the public.
paragraphs.zh: 此情況也凸顯了梵蒂岡處理領袖健康資訊方式的轉變。透過公開談論自己的病情，利奧十四世改變了前任教宗較為隱晦的做法。過去，梵蒂岡常因對教宗健康狀況交代模糊不清而受到批評。選擇保持透明，顯示現任行政團隊正為大眾提供更直接的最新消息。

paragraphs.en: While the Pope is generally considered to be in good health, his family history suggests a personal connection to the illness. According to NPR, both his mother and his older brother have faced battles with cancer. Despite these challenges, the Pope's associates remain optimistic. Cardinal Kikuchi Tarcisio Isao of Tokyo, who met with the Pope just one day before the surgery, noted that the pontiff felt no physical symptoms of illness at that time. As the Pope begins his recovery, the world continues to watch and wait for further updates on his progress.
paragraphs.zh: 雖然教宗普遍被認為身體狀況良好，但其家族病史顯示他與此疾病有個人連結。根據美國國家公共廣播電台（NPR）報導，他的母親與哥哥都曾與癌症搏鬥。儘管面臨這些挑戰，教宗的同僚仍保持樂觀。在手術前一天曾與教宗會面的東京菊地功樞機（Cardinal Kikuchi Tarcisio Isao）指出，教宗當時並未感到任何身體不適。隨著教宗開始康復，全世界持續關注並等待他進一步的復原進度。

previousArticles.summaryEn: Pope Leo has been diagnosed with lung cancer after doctors found a growth on his lung. The 71-year-old leader underwent a successful surgery to remove part of his right lung. Vatican officials confirmed the diagnosis after tests were completed during the operation. The Pope is currently resting in a hospital in Rome and has cancelled his public meetings until October 20. Church leaders are hopeful for his recovery as the condition was caught early.

quiz.question: What specific action did the surgeons take during the Pope's operation at Gemelli Hospital?

options.A: They removed the entire right lung to prevent the cancer from spreading.
options.B: They removed the lower section of the Pope's right lung.
options.C: They performed a biopsy on a nodule found in the left lung.
options.D: They removed a cancerous growth from the upper lobe of his lung.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第一段，外科醫生切除了教宗右肺的下葉（lower lobe），以確保手術徹底。選項 A 錯誤，因為只切除了下葉而非整個肺部；選項 C 錯誤，因為問題是右肺而非左肺；選項 D 錯誤，因為切除的是下葉而非上葉。

quiz.question: Why is the Pope particularly determined to maintain his upcoming travel plans despite his surgery?

options.A: He wants to prove to the public that he has fully recovered from his illness.
options.B: He is required by Vatican law to visit Latin America every year.
options.C: He has a personal history and deep emotional connection to the region he plans to visit.
options.D: He believes that the medical treatment he received will be more effective if he stays active.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據文章第三段，教宗急於維持行程是因為他曾在那裡擔任傳教士和主教多年，這段經歷對他而言意義重大。選項 A 並非文中提到的動機；選項 B 文中未提及任何法律規定；選項 D 則是對文章內容的過度推論，文中並未將旅行與治療效果掛鉤。

quiz.question: In the fourth paragraph, what does the phrase 'bolt from the blue' mean as used by Cardinal Parolin?

options.A: A sudden and completely unexpected event.
options.B: A piece of news that brings great relief.
options.C: A decision that was carefully planned in secret.
options.D: A weather-related delay that affected the surgery.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。'Bolt from the blue' 是一個慣用語，意指「晴天霹靂」或「突如其來的意外消息」。文中樞機主教用此詞形容教宗患病的消息令人驚訝。選項 B 錯誤，因為這不是令人寬慰的消息；選項 C 與原意相反；選項 D 則是將該詞誤解為字面上的天氣現象。

options.A: To provide a detailed medical history of the current Pope's family.
options.B: To criticize the Vatican's past handling of medical information.
options.C: To report on the Pope's recent surgery and the shift toward transparency in the Vatican.
options.D: To explain the specific risks associated with lung adenocarcinoma in elderly patients.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。這篇文章的核心在於報導教宗的手術狀況，並特別提到教宗選擇公開病情，這與梵蒂岡過去較為封閉的做法形成鮮明對比。選項 A 僅是背景資訊；選項 B 雖然提到批評，但並非文章主旨；選項 D 則過於偏重醫學細節，忽略了新聞報導的重點。
